findings.description: After the V172 increase in native Cloth bending stiffness, direct front/back/side/three-quarter inspection still shows heavily crumpled angular overskirt folds, unequal side lift and collapse, and stacked lilac hem bands on both side profiles. The solver adjustment does not yield a continuous, balanced skirt edge.

Irregular gray body-colored patches remain visible across the white chest and waist in neutral, arms-up and arm-cross renders. Current renders do not isolate whether these are intersections, exposed source surfaces, or shading; the cause remains unresolved.
In crouch and sit, both shorts-clad thighs visibly project in front of the overskirt while the center front panel falls behind them. Coverage and clearance remain unacceptable in bent-leg poses.

nextAction: Keep V172 rejected and do not repeat cloth stiffness tuning alone. Measure per-panel pre/post-bake displacement, vertex inversion and signed clearance against the exact target body; trace the doubled hem segments to their source edge bindings; then repair the skirt panel geometry/attachments and bent-leg trajectory. Separately isolate the bodice gray patches against the target body surface before changing top geometry. Regenerate and directly inspect all eleven renders after a source correction. Numeric fit, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging, and release remain unverified.
